# Prompt Lingo (Noizu Prompt Lingo)

> Open syntax conventions for structured prompts, served over a public MCP.

Site: https://promptlingo.dev
Repo: https://github.com/noizu-labs-ml/NoizuPromptLingo (MIT)

## What it is

A versioned convention language: placeholders, intuition pumps, directives, prefixes, tagged prompt sections. Agents load pieces on demand via MCP tools `NPLLoad` and `NPLSpec`. No account required.

This is not agent-kit (sessions, tickets, chat). Promptlingo is the language those agents load.

## MCP

- Endpoint: https://promptlingo.dev/mcp
- Tools: NPLLoad, NPLSpec
- Auth: none required

```
claude mcp add --transport http npl https://promptlingo.dev/mcp
```

## Corpus

YAML in `conventions/` in the git repo. Examples include system/assistant threads (prompt + generated output).

## VFS

Read-only markdown tree at `wss://promptlingo.dev/vfs` under `tobor/_npl/sections/*.md`.
